title: The High Price of India’s iPhone Manufacturing Boom
description: India now makes one in four iPhones, but its dependence on imported components remains substantial. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Andy Mukherjee says the country's manufacturing gains may not justify the growing taxpayer subsidies needed to replicate China's success. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Spain Eases Data Center Energy Rules in Win for Big Tech
description: Spain is easing rules for data center power usage after an initial government proposal faced strong industry backlash.

title: AirTrunk Secures $3 Billion Green Loan for Sydney Data Center
description: AirTrunk secured a A$4.25 billion ($3 billion) green loan to finance the development of a Sydney data center campus, a signal of confidence in a sector that’s taken a slew of hits in recent weeks.
